name: LVIS v1 annotations (YOLO-format repackaging) on COCO 2017 images
paper: A. Gupta, P. Dollar, R. Girshick, LVIS: A Dataset for Large Vocabulary Instance Segmentation, CVPR 2019, arXiv:1908.03195
acquisition_note: dl.fbaipublicfiles.com (official LVIS json) is not reachable here; the Ultralytics repackaging keeps the LVIS category order, names come from its lvis.yaml. Used only to count which annotated objects fall outside the detectors' vocabulary; images are the COCO ones.
storage: data/raw/lvis_v1_labels (git-ignored; RD_DATA_DIR overrides the data root)
